```{r paths}
USER <- Sys.getenv("USER")
source("../../../0_utils/paths.R")

# Outputs from 04_tc_event_spot_check.py
input_dir <- file.path(
  DIR_REPO_RAINFALL_MORTALITY, "output", "data", "wind_precip_confounding",
  "tc_event_spot_check"
)

summary_file <- file.path(input_dir, "tc_event_summary.csv")
top_admins_file <- file.path(input_dir, "tc_event_top_admins.csv")
admin_day_file <- file.path(input_dir, "tc_event_admin_day.csv")
```

This report checks whether ERA5-Land daily wind shows clear spikes around 12
major tropical cyclone events in our sample.

The event list started from an AI-generated list of prominent storms. I checked
each event manually before using it here.

This is only a spot/sanity check. It is a quick way to check the wind data
without using storm tracks. It doesn't identify all cyclone-exposed admin units.

```{r read-data}
summary <- read_csv(summary_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
top_admins <- read_csv(top_admins_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
admin_day <- read_csv(admin_day_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
```

```{r table-functions}
# Format numbers, percentages, and dates for the tables
fmt_num <- function(x, digits = 1) {
  ifelse(is.na(x), "", format(round(x, digits), nsmall = digits, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE))
}

fmt_pct <- function(x) {
  ifelse(is.na(x), "", format(round(100 * x, 1), nsmall = 1, trim = TRUE))
}

fmt_date <- function(x) {
  ifelse(is.na(x), "", format(as.Date(x), "%Y-%m-%d"))
}

show_table <- function(data, height = "520px") {
  data %>%
    kable(format = "html", escape = FALSE) %>%
    kable_styling(
      bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
      full_width = FALSE,
      font_size = 13
    ) %>%
    scroll_box(width = "100%", height = height, extra_css = "border: 1px solid #d9e2e7;")
}
```

## Event Summary

One row per storm. This table shows where ERA5-Land wind is highest during each
event window.

```{r event-summary}
summary %>%
  transmute(
    Storm = storm_name,
    Country = country,
    `Event date` = fmt_date(event_date),
    `Known affected places` = known_places,
    `Top admin by admin-mean wind` = top_pop_wind_place,
    `Admin-mean wind max (m/s)` = fmt_num(top_pop_wind_ms),
    `Date of admin-mean wind max` = fmt_date(top_pop_wind_date),
    `Rain in that admin max (mm)` = fmt_num(top_pop_wind_admin_max_prcp_mm),
    `Top admin by max grid-cell wind` = top_cell_wind_place,
    `Max grid-cell wind (m/s)` = fmt_num(top_cell_wind_ms),
    `Date of max grid-cell wind` = fmt_date(top_cell_wind_date)
  ) %>%
  show_table(height = "420px")
```

## Top Admin Units

Top admin units for each storm, ranked by wind during the event window.

```{r top-admins}
top_admins %>%
  transmute(
    Storm = storm_name,
    Country = country,
    `Rank by admin-mean wind` = rank_by_wind_pop,
    `Rank by max grid-cell wind` = rank_by_cell_wind_pop,
    `Admin unit` = place_label,
    `Region ID` = region_id,
    `Admin-mean wind max (m/s)` = fmt_num(max_wind_pop_ms),
    `Max grid-cell wind (m/s)` = fmt_num(max_cell_wind_pop_ms),
    `Max pop share above 17.5 m/s (%)` = fmt_pct(max_pop_share_above_17p5),
    `Max rain (mm)` = fmt_num(max_prcp_mm),
    `Date of admin-mean wind max` = fmt_date(date_max_wind_pop),
    `Date of max grid-cell wind` = fmt_date(date_max_cell_wind_pop),
    `Date of max rain` = fmt_date(date_max_prcp)
  ) %>%
  show_table(height = "560px")
```

## Daily Values for Top 5 Admin Units

Daily wind and rain values for the five highest-wind admin units in each storm.

```{r daily-values}
# Keep the five highest admin units by population-weighted mean wind
top5_admins <- top_admins %>%
  filter(rank_by_wind_pop <= 5) %>%
  select(event_id, region_id, rank_by_wind_pop, place_label)

# Keep daily values for those admin units
admin_day %>%
  inner_join(top5_admins, by = c("event_id", "region_id")) %>%
  arrange(event_id, rank_by_wind_pop, date) %>%
  transmute(
    Storm = storm_name,
    Country = country,
    Date = fmt_date(date),
    `Rank by admin-mean wind` = rank_by_wind_pop,
    `Admin unit` = place_label,
    `Region ID` = region_id,
    `Admin-mean wind (m/s)` = fmt_num(windmax_pop_day),
    `Max grid-cell wind (m/s)` = fmt_num(windcellmax_pop_day),
    `Pop share above 17.5 m/s (%)` = fmt_pct(windshare_17p5_pop_day),
    `Rain (mm)` = fmt_num(prcp_pop_p1)
  ) %>%
  show_table(height = "620px")
```
